basic_profile.bio: Hey there! I'm Alex, a 24-year-old student living in Los Angeles. I'm currently studying graphic design and have a budding interest in disc dyeing—it's like art meets sport! In my downtime, I enjoy watching TV series like 'Bones' and have a soft spot for crime dramas. I'm also exploring the LGBTQ+ community in LA and love connecting with fellow gay bros. I'm usually online late at night after classes or on weekends when I'm not out exploring the city. Currently single, but open to meeting new people!

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Most of my knowledge comes from my graphic design studies and my personal interest in TV shows and series. I've picked up a lot about disc dyeing through online tutorials and practice. As a student, I'm always learning new things about design and art.
